content.title: Bad prompt vs Good prompt
content.bad: Make me an app to manage leave requests. Use Apps Script, save the data to Google Sheets and deploy it as a web app. Make it look nice and let the manager approve requests. Give me the code and tell me how to run it.

pages.title: 1. Roles and interface
paragraphs: Act as an Apps Script developer. Build a leave-management web app for employees, managers and HR, backed by Google Sheets.
Create a form for leave type, dates and reason. Employees see their own requests and status; managers see requests awaiting their decision. Use a responsive interface with loading and error states.

pages.title: 2. Sheet structure
paragraphs: Provide a Requests sheet: request ID, employee, manager, start/end dates, leave type, reason, status, submission time, reviewer, decision time and decision note.
Keep employee-to-manager assignments and leave balances separately. Include sample rows. Validate required fields, date order, available balance and overlapping active requests on the server.

pages.title: 3. Approval flow
paragraphs: New requests start as Pending. Only the assigned manager can approve or reject them. Rejection requires a reason. Employees can cancel their own Pending requests.
Prevent duplicate or conflicting decisions. Save the decision and its audit record before notifying the employee. Refresh the displayed status only after the save succeeds.

pages.title: 4. Identity and access
paragraphs: Verify identity and roles on the server; never trust browser-supplied email or role. Employees cannot view others’ requests or approve their own leave.
Explain deployment identity and audience settings. Verify that this configuration supports user identification and permissions; ask for clarification if it cannot.

pages.title: 5. Deliver and verify
paragraphs: Return complete Code.gs, Index.html, sheet schema, sample data, setup instructions and web-app deployment steps.

Test submission, approval, rejection, cancellation, invalid dates, overlap, unauthorized access and duplicate decisions. Check the saved rows in Sheets. Failed writes must show an error rather than success. Explain how to reproduce each test.

slides.definition: A prompt is an instruction or question you give AI to guide its response.

caution.title: Caution
caution.warning: Never use AI answers carelessly. Verify them before sending or acting.
caution.check: Check names, facts, dates and tone. Remove AI commentary before sending.

paragraphs: I am writing to request feedback on my Business Analytics research proposal. I have attached the draft, including my research question and proposed data sources.
Could we meet next week? I am available on Tuesday or Thursday afternoon and can adjust to your schedule. Thank you for your time and guidance.

content.title: From a need to a web app
steps: Know your need
Describe who will use the app, what they need to do and the expected result.
Write a prompt
Give AI the workflow, data fields, rules and desired interface. Ask for code and setup steps.
Let AI write the code
Ask for complete Code.gs and HTML files. Review the instructions and use sample data.
Copy, paste and deploy
Paste and test the files. Deploy as a Web app, choose access and check its /exec link.

content.title: Gemini · Add a skill
steps: Open Customize > Skills. If your account still uses Gems, open its instructions instead.
Choose Create > Upload. Add SKILL.md, or a folder/ZIP containing it, then review the instructions.
Create and activate the skill. Select it with / or @, or let Gemini use it when relevant.

content.title: ChatGPT · Add a skill
steps: Open Plugins > Skills in an eligible workspace.
Choose Create > Upload from your computer, or create a skill in chat.
Install the skill and test a matching task. ChatGPT can use relevant skills automatically.

content.title: Claude · Add a skill
steps: Enable code execution and file creation in Settings.
Open Customize > Skills > + > Create skill > Upload a skill. Upload the ZIP containing your skill folder.
Turn the skill on and test a matching task. Claude uses relevant skills automatically.
